### Highlights

- The first-run experience is now an interactive five-step Product Tour that spotlights the actual Switch Center, settings entry, shared-display selector, host-pairing area, and save action.
- The tour moves to the relevant page, scrolls the highlighted control into view, positions its tooltip around the available space, and can be reopened from Help at any time.
- Existing installations are not mistaken for new installations, while completing or skipping the tour is saved for future launches.

### Update experience

- Update release notes now render common Markdown formatting in a larger, scrollable dialog instead of showing raw Markdown source.
- Help now includes a Release History table with each release date, version, and a direct GitHub link for checking full version details.

### Compatibility

- The Product Tour and update-note improvements support both Windows and macOS and do not change existing display, host, autostart, or update preferences.

### Known limitations

- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may require manual approval.
- Some MST, DisplayLink, and Silicon Motion docks do not forward DDC/CI. Software cannot restore control signals that the hardware does not expose.
